title: Vocabulary & Usage
description: Build Grade 6 vocabulary: synonyms, antonyms, homophones and homonyms, one-word substitution and common idioms — with bilingual notes, examples, practice and tests.

topics.title: Synonyms, Antonyms & Homophones
topics.concept:
Synonyms are words with the same or similar meaning: big = large, fast = quick, happy = glad. They help you avoid repeating the same word.

Antonyms are words with opposite meanings: hot × cold, begin × end, ancient × modern.

Homophones sound the same but are spelt differently and mean different things:

WordMeaning
theirbelonging to them
therethat place
they'rethey are
to / too / twotowards / also / 2
write / rightto put on paper / correct

A related idea is the homonym: one spelling, two meanings — bat (animal / cricket bat).

topics.title: One-Word Substitution & Idioms
topics.concept:
One-word substitution replaces a whole phrase with a single precise word:

PhraseOne Word
a person who cannot read or writeilliterate
one who studies starsastronomer
a place where books are keptlibrary
animals that eat only plantsherbivores

Idioms are colourful phrases whose meaning is not literal:

  • a piece of cake = very easy
  • once in a blue moon = very rarely
  • let the cat out of the bag = reveal a secret
  • break the ice = start a conversation

examples.problem: One word for 'a doctor who treats teeth'.
What does 'a piece of cake' mean?
examples.solution: Something very easy — it is an idiom, not about real cake.

recap: One-word substitution = one precise word for a phrase
'a piece of cake' = easy; 'break the ice' = start talking

intro.en: A strong vocabulary lets you say exactly what you mean. This chapter sharpens four tools: synonyms (same meaning), antonyms (opposite meaning), homophones (sound alike, spelt differently), and idioms (phrases with a hidden meaning). Together they make your English clearer and more colourful.
intro.hi: अच्छी शब्द-सम्पदा (Vocabulary) से आप ठीक वही कह पाते हैं जो आपका अर्थ है। यह अध्याय चार उपकरण तेज़ करता है: पर्यायवाची (synonyms), विलोम (antonyms), समोच्चारित (homophones), और मुहावरे (idioms)। ये मिलकर आपकी अंग्रेज़ी को स्पष्ट और रोचक बनाते हैं।

real_life.situation:
You write a message but autocorrect plays tricks:

Wrong: Their going to they're house over there.

Right: They're going to their house over there.
real_life.why: They're, their, there sound the same but mean different things — these are homophones. Choosing the wrong one changes the meaning. Knowing them keeps your writing correct.

reading.passage: The science quiz was a piece of cake for Aryan. He answered every question quickly and correctly. "You're a star!" said his friend. Although Aryan rarely showed off — only once in a blue moon — he felt very glad. Their teacher praised the whole team for breaking the ice with the visiting students.

questions.q: What does 'a piece of cake' mean here?
questions.answer: Very easy — the quiz was easy for Aryan.

questions.answer: Starting a friendly conversation with people you don't know well.
